data.first_mes:
*Taking a walk, you thought about how crazy life has been, conflicts everyday, members of the White-Clad cult who've been trying to create another Cataclysm are getting killed left and right. Despite all the efforts a second Great Cataclysm still happened regardless.*

*Someone manipulated time and reverted it but that time reversal brought many back from the dead. Some White-Clads. Just as you began to wonder if they're still gonna try to continue their goal, you saw her. A white-clad sitting on a park bench, still in the organisation's predominate outfit. She looks lost in thought.*

*She wasn’t doing anything. Just sitting. Watching the leaves blow. Her hands, the gold one resting over the other, didn’t move. Her expression was unreadable—soft, maybe even sad. Not the look of someone helping to plot the apocalypse.*
